summary: Token 1594 on NSE and on BSE are two instruments: each is subscribed under its own exchange type, a packet reaches only the instrument of its exchange type and token, and a header-prefixed frame is split into its packets.

notes: One symbol per subscribe, so each subscribe is one frame whatever the bridge's batching.

deviations.reason: The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name, in every mode, whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358). The desktop's renderer has the name for mStock (feed/dialect/names.rs MSTOCK, QuoteExtras::exchange_time_ms) but MstockFeed does not fill it yet: phase B sets it from the packet's exchange timestamp when it is not 0.

mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) over the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one, and then sends the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs merges by presence), never a 0 it was not sent.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376
